AI Chore Tips returns helpful age-appropriate tips as text
AI Family Activity returns structured JSON with activities array containing name, description, duration, setting, supplies_needed, fun_factor
All AI endpoints properly handle JSON parsing with fallback to text response if parsing fails
Points adjustment correctly handles both positive (add) and negative (deduct) amounts with floor at 0
Shopping list auto-approves parent items, keeps child items pending
Chore claim functionality works correctly for unassigned chores
